title: The Ghostly Disappearance at Eilean Mòr Lighthouse
description: In December 1900, three highly experienced lighthouse keepers vanished without a trace from the remote island of Eilean Mòr in Scotland's Flannan Isles. When relief keeper Joseph Moore arrived, he discovered a locked, empty lighthouse, a clean kitchen, and a series of baffling clues that have puzzled maritime historians for over a century. This documentary explores the official investigation led by Robert Muirhead, the structural damage on the island, and the truth behind the myths of the Flannan Isles mystery.
